description: Scout connector telemetry, session-token accounting and the restrict_tools MCP gate. Activate only inside scout runs: SCOUT_MODE from the runner, or, for a session started inside a vault without a runner, the run mode its prompt names (scout/hooks/run_context.py). Interactive sessions are skipped. The PreToolUse gate skips Python unless the session's vault (SCOUT_DATA_DIR, else the one containing the working directory) uses restrict_tools in connectors.custom.yaml. Per #72, per-tool-call accounting was moved out of PostToolUse (which fired one Python cold-start per tool call) into the session-tool-log Stop hook that walks the transcript once at session end.

hooks.command: d="$SCOUT_DATA_DIR"; if [ -z "$d" ]; then d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -f "$d/scout-config.yaml" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; fi; grep -qs restrict_tools "$d/connectors.custom.yaml" || exit 0; exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/engine/bin/scoutctl" hook mcp-tool-gate
